from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
W,H=1000,600
img=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'white')
d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
d.text((50,50),'Settings region (Cassette selected)',fill=(0,0,0))
d.text((50,120),'Screen: Cassette',fill=(0,0,0))
d.text((50,160),'Cassette variant: Tape Mono',fill=(0,0,0))
d.text((50,200),'Text size: 1.0',fill=(0,0,0))
d.text((50,240),'Haptics: On',fill=(0,0,0))
img.save('/workspace/screenshot_settings_cassette.png')
print('screenshot created')
